name: Shouki Letitia ~Koyoi, Oujo wa Haru o Uru~
original_name: 娼姫レティシア～今宵、王女は春を売る～
source:
Estor Kingdom is blessed with rich nature. It exists in stability for over a hundred years until king falls ill. At this time minister's coup breaks out. As a result, king is imprisoned and the princess and queen are captured. But minister can't reign himself as people would overthrow the usurper. He blackmails princess and queen with king's life and coerces them into being trained by protagonist who is a high class courtesan trainer. They can only leave this building as complete whores.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
埃斯托尔王国自然资源丰饶，百余年来一直安定繁荣，直到国王病倒。此时，大臣发动政变，囚禁国王并抓住公主与王后。然而篡位者无法直接统治，否则人民必会推翻他。大臣以国王性命威胁公主和王后，强迫她们接受主角这名高级娼妓调教师的训练。蕾蒂西亚与凯瑟琳只有被彻底调教成娼妇后，才能离开这栋建筑。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
